decisions.reason: Although it fits the therapeutic core and likely required meaningful setup effort, its complete disappearance from the 2024 website after only a short launch suggests the firm's visible commitment never became strong enough to justify continued escalation.
The custom-furniture workshop is more peripheral to the firm's main care mission, and once it vanished from the website in 2024 there was little public commitment left to defend further investment.
The outpatient sociotherapy service moved from a simple mention to the home page, signaling growing public commitment to a core adjacent offer and making management likely to continue backing it.
Its home-page presence in both 2023 and 2024 shows sustained visible commitment and strong fit with the firm's eldercare direction, which favors continuation.

The retail shop gained prominence from a website mention to the home page, and as an extension of sheltered-workshop activity it aligns with the firm's inclusion-oriented model enough to sustain commitment.
Because the meal delivery service was only launched in 2024 and is close to the core senior-support offer, management would likely attribute any early weaknesses to rollout and keep it for longer.
